01The place

Some places ask
you to do more.
Here, simply be.

Tucked into a quiet corner of the western fjords, Friðr is a place to put the everyday down.

Eighteen thoughtful rooms. Fire-warmed evenings. Saunas that float between mountain and sky. Come with someone you love, and leave a little more like yourself.

18 rooms   /   2 floating saunas
More space for the two of you.

03The daily ritual

Heat. Plunge.
Come back
to yourself.

The crackle of birchwood. Steam in the cold air. The fjord, right at your feet. Our two floating saunas invite you into a rhythm as old as the landscape.

01 Warm up02 Cool down03 Let go

04A little further afield

Let the day find you.

No full itineraries. Just a few good reasons
to step outside. Or stay a little longer.

Follow the shoreline. Find a forest trail. Take a flask of something warm and see where you end up.

Drift between the mountains with a local skipper. Out here, the silence has a way of filling everything.

What the fjord gives us. What the season brings. Thoughtful food, candlelight, and no reason to rush.

Sometimes, the best plan is a little less of one.

A little distance. A deeper connection.

Leave the busy behind.
We’ll keep the fire on.

A few quiet days can make all the difference.

Friðr is a fictional boutique hotel, created as an independent hospitality website concept. All hotel, room, sauna, and experience photographs were generated specifically for this project.
